He became chairman of the business and assembled a management team for its planned revival in Tampa, Florida, offering a new range of luxury motor yachts and sportfishing boats.

long_biography.plain_text:
Henry Respess came to Westship as a customer before becoming its owner. Working with the design team on a commission gave him a close view of the company's manufacturing quality and suggested an opportunity to invest. His acquisition followed several years of watching the builder's development.

The revival plan drew on an existing production platform. Westship retained manufacturing infrastructure and expertise in composite fibreglass construction, including resin-infusion methods. Respess also brought forward new designs by Evan Marshall and the Arabitto team. The proposed range combined the acquired production capabilities with outside design expertise, rather than requiring a shipbuilding operation to be created from scratch.
